name: OneRecord inbox-triage blind test set v1
protocol: Written and hand-labelled BEFORE the author read src/lib/engine/triage.ts or its tests; never used to tune the rules. sha256 of messages recorded at write time so later edits are detectable.
pseudonymised: 2026-10-28 (pre-publication): real hospital, lab and chain names in from/subject/body/note were replaced with fictional ones (and PO-number prefixes derived from them). Labels, wording and message structure are unchanged; sha256 was recomputed over the edited messages (json.dumps(messages, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)).

labelPolicy.po: Confirmed order that carries a customer PO / order number (incl. 'P/O', 'order no ... raised in Ariba').
labelPolicy.pr: Committed intent to buy a specific product + quantity (quote accepted, requisition approved) but NO PO number yet.
labelPolicy.enquiry: Price / availability / spec / regulatory question with no commitment (a quantity may appear).
labelPolicy.followup: About an existing order: delivery, short-ship, backorder, invoice, payment, documents, installation, amendment.
labelPolicy.mdm: Asks to create/extend/change a customer, vendor or item record: new account, bill-to, ship-to, name/tax ID, new item code.
labelPolicy.mixed: One label per message = the primary action the inbox owner must take. A PO with a ship-to aside is 'po'; a message whose blocking ask is a record change is 'mdm'.
